rationale: No supported optimization's preconditions are safely met for this reusable e2e workflow. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is contraindicated because the workflow already caches node_modules, Cypress, Next.js, package dist, and CocoaPods (equivalent cache already exists). Matrix fail-fast (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST) is already GitHub's default behavior and would reduce required cross-framework e2e diagnostics, which the unverified required-checks contract likely requires. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT and P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT need representative successful-duration history, but the repository has no completed runs, and a fixed timeout risks failing valid slow e2e runs that pull AWS environments and start emulators/simulators (contraindication: valid slow runs exceed the limit); the measured timeout experiment is a different, much faster Checks workflow. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE cannot be reliably scoped by PR/branch because this workflow_call receives only commit/repository inputs, so cancel-in-progress could cancel unrelated runs. Test selection/skip patterns would reduce required e2e coverage. Bazel patterns do not apply (no Bazel build).
